map.展柜温湿度监控 使用指南: Display Case Temperature and Humidity Monitor User Guide
map.选择文物材质（金属、陶瓷、书画、丝织品、漆木器等），录入展柜实测温湿度，对照保存: Choose the relic material (metal, ceramic, painting and calligraphy, silk, lacquered wood, and so on) and enter the measured temperature and humidity in the display case to compare against preservation standards and get control advice. It is used for museum collection environmental monitoring and preventive conservation.
map.文物入库/布展前，按材质（金属/陶瓷/书画/丝织/漆木等）查对应推荐温湿度范围，: Before a relic enters storage or goes on display, look up the recommended temperature and humidity range for its material (metal, ceramic, painting and calligraphy, silk, lacquered wood, and so on) and check the measured values in the display case against it.
map.日常监测时，记录温湿度日波动，对照材质允差判断是否需增除湿/调温设备，防止金属锈: In daily monitoring, record the day-to-day swing in temperature and humidity and compare it with the material tolerance to decide whether to add dehumidification or temperature control equipment, preventing metal corrosion, paper embrittlement, and wood cracking.
map.环境超标告警时，给出针对性调控建议（升温/降温、加湿/除湿）直至回到达标区间。: When the environment exceeds limits, give targeted control advice (warming or cooling, humidifying or dehumidifying) until it returns to the compliant range.
map.材质环境达标校验示例: Example of checking a material against its environment requirements
map.：某书画类展品推荐温度 18~20℃、湿度 50~55%。实测 19℃、52%: : A painting and calligraphy exhibit is recommended at 18–20 °C and 50–55% humidity. Measured 19 °C and 52% → both fall in range and it is compliant. At 22 °C and 45% the temperature exceeds the 20 °C upper limit (non-compliant, cool below 20 °C) and although humidity is near the 50–55% lower bound it is too low. Metal instead requires humidity <40% against rust, while paintings need 50–55% against drying cracks; the two standards must not be mixed.
map.不同材质温湿度为什么差别这么大？: Why Do Temperature and Humidity Requirements Differ So Much by Material?
map.材质吸湿/热胀特性不同：金属/皮革怕潮（金属<40%、皮革 50~60%），书画: Materials differ in hygroscopic and thermal expansion behaviour: metal and leather fear moisture (metal <40%, leather 50–60%), paintings and silk fear dryness and light (50–55% at low illuminance), and lacquered wood and bamboo need moisture (55–65%) to avoid cracking. Mixing them in one cabinet forces trade-offs, so control each cabinet by material.
map.日波动为什么也要控？: Why Should the Daily Swing Be Controlled Too?
map.短期剧烈温湿波动会引发材料反复胀缩、凝结水与霉变，比均值偏差更伤文物。行业要求温: Sharp short-term temperature and humidity swings make materials expand and contract repeatedly, cause condensation and mould, and damage relics more than a deviation in the average. The industry requires a daily temperature swing of ≤±2~3 °C and humidity of ≤±5%, so continuous monitoring rather than spot readings is needed.
